The following events took place in '''1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 34''' after the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*[[Galen Marek]] was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />
*[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], retired from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] after 31 years of service in both the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Senates and was replaced by his adopted daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].
*Darth Vader was [[Assault on Kamino|defeated]] by a [[Subject 1138|renegade clone]] of his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] on Kamino. After becoming a [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Vader was in the process of being [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the Alliance's [[Dantooine base/Legends|hidden base]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />
*The Rebellion was forced to secretly abandon their base on Dantooine, due to [[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]] discovering an Imperial [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and moved to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], discovered by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]].<ref name="Star Wars Insider 92">[[Star Wars Insider 92|''Star Wars Insider'' 92]]</ref>
*[[Gaeriel Captison]] was elected to the [[Bakuran Senate]].<ref name="Databank:Gaeriel Captison">{{DB|character|gaerielcaptison|Captison, Gaeriel}}</ref>
*[[Shadowcast]] was established.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
*The [[Gladiator/Legends|Gladiators]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] quarreled for land. [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] escaped Rodia and went to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
*[[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] was [[Subjugation of Sulon|conquered]] by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="DF:SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>
*The Galactic Empire was at its territorial and [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] height.
*A group of conspirators led by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]] [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|attempted a coup]] on [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Darth Vader.<ref name="e1:b1" />
*[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] assumed control of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].
*[[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
*The [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] and [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] were contaminated by the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] [[virus]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the majority of both of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' crew members and turning them into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>
*Palpatine ordered the original manuscript of the ''[[Sayings]]'' to be confiscated from the [[Atrisian Imperial Historical Library]] and transferred to the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Imperial Museum]] on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] "for its great historical value to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]". The manuscript arrived with a small amount of fanfare, was briefly displayed, and soon vanished into Palpatine's private holdings.<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
*A debriefing occurred on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], held by Dr. [[Insmot Bowen]] of the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]] and attended by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arhul Kurumenga]] of the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], and [[Master of Imperial Projects]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]], relating to discoveries pertaining to the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] and the [[Rakatan revolt]] against them.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>
*The [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] were [[Death Star Uprising|stolen]] from the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] itself by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
*After nineteen years the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] comes to an end as the Empire shifts its focus from hunting down the few surviving members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], to dealing with the growing Rebellion.
*The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the war-torn planet [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] mysteriously disappears.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
*35:1&mdash;The Galactic Empire takes direct control of the [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] government and disbands the local [[Dentaalian House|parliament]].<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

*[[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]<ref>The Battle of Turkana takes place after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]<nowiki/>'s second tour of duty. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Events in ''Star Wars: X-Wing'' before the end of the second tour of duty therefore take place in 1 BBY.</ref>
*[[Rescue at Mon Calamari]]<ref>According to ''X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide'', this engagement follows the adoption of the T-65 X-wing starfighter by the Rebel Alliance, which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to 1 BBY, and precedes the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Therefore, events occurring between the X-wing's adoption and Organa's capture must take place in 1 BBY.</ref>
